item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 03/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense northeast monsoon will bring cold weather to Guangdong tomorrow. The weather will improve over the region. It will be dry during the day. Under the influence of a fresh to strong easterly airstream, it will be cloudier with one or two light rain patches over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. The weather will remain cool in the morning. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China again over the weekend. It will become cold over the region.

Date/Month: 04/02 (Tuesday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first. East force 4 later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy and cold in the morning. Dry with sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 12 - 17 C
R.H. range: 50 - 75 per Cent
PSR: Low
